title: Abdominal Pain and Diarrhea - Internal Medicine Rotem Caretta
hpi_raw: Mr Caretta is a middle-aged man with no significant past medical history who presents with abdominal pain and diarrhea. Onset is acute, the character is crampy, severity is moderate, associated symptoms include loose stools with occasional blood, pertinent negatives include normal heart and lung examination.
hpi_narrative: A middle-aged man with no significant past medical history presents with acute onset of abdominal pain and diarrhea. The character is crampy, severity moderate, associated symptoms include loose stools with occasional blood, and pertinent negatives include normal heart and lung examination.
